smokeScope: CI SDK/native artifacts from testedCommit (run 38026845621: android-aar and native-android, identical .so sha256 per ABI, and identical again inside the harness APK; arm64-v8a f791b838058cfb02e57b82490a0ed20922229fa30835552c3152d9b7fbdc5dc0, armeabi-v7a a7e6e9b0e7643a8398ca6ee7bd55a7131e594823a0568f3ee74d4ff2a6c642d1) in an isolated Testnet sample with a random seed and no INTERNET permission: create, cold reopen, PublicOffline receive token, Regular receive token parsed back as Regular by the stateless parser (new in this release), unfunded offline quote rejected, empty send inventory after reopen; no network start or send. The two ABIs used separate runIds (38026845621 and 38026845621-v7a). The harness has no funds and never starts the wallet, so the interactive (Regular) send path, cancelTransaction durability and concurrent-send admission are covered off-device by the native host tests (send_admission_test REGULAR_SEND_OK and the cancel/legacy-record scenarios, stateless_codec_test STATELESS_REGULAR_OK, offline_signer_test ONLINE_ONLY) and the Kotlin JNI fixture tests on the same source.
